authority.scope: V5.3 public-backbone effect learning, policy correctness, response evaluation, and failure attribution

supersedes.reason: V5.3 learns continuous replicate-aggregated paired effects rather than a construction-derived binary opportunity label; the older response quality, risk, and cost definitions remain useful where explicitly carried forward below

also_supersedes.reason: the development pilot selected and froze the continuous formal target and representation after the public-backbone contract's provisional binary gate

research_question: Conditional on a frozen, deployment-visible current state and a frozen actual Rank-1 candidate, can a low-capacity PM predict the candidate's conditional marginal support contribution and select a safe, low-cost action better than fixed or transparent policies?

semantic_scope.in_scope: bounded deployable semantic representation of the current dialogue, candidate, explicit boundaries, time, owner, redundancy, and action readiness
semantic_scope.fixed_encoder_role: BGE-family embeddings are frozen representations, not a claim of complete language understanding
semantic_scope.out_of_scope: unrestricted human-level pragmatic inference, diagnosis, hidden intent, and universal natural-language understanding
semantic_scope.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN or out-of-support semantics are not negative gold; they are abstain/fail-closed-to-OFF or transparent-rule cases and are reported separately
semantic_scope.claim_wording: The experiment conditions on candidate discovery and a bounded semantic interface; it does not assume that semantic error is impossible

analysis_grain.effect_group: one frozen state, one frozen actual Rank-1 candidate, one requested component, and three paired ON/OFF generator seeds

Q.name: positive_support_contribution
Q.role: primary component training target and response benefit axis
Q.definition: replicate-aggregated ON-minus-OFF contribution over goal advance, emotional support, specific useful contribution, and clarity/naturalness

R.name: material_interaction_and_grounding_risk
R.definition: absolute events in both arms plus resource-attributable direction for explicit-boundary violation, unsupported/wrong-owner personal grounding, and excessive directiveness/burden
R.critical_events: severity 3 or machine-provable wrong-owner/future/private-source fabrication; never hidden in a pooled rate

F.name: functional_execution
F.definition: requested evidence was received, used for its required contribution, grounded to the right owner/time, and realized without scaffold exposure or atomic-move violation

C.name: resource_and_generation_cost
C.role: joint-action projection and separate reporting only
C.definition: injected items, provider-recorded input/output tokens, latency, fallback/recovery, and monetary cost

D.name: decision_correctness
D.definition: component resolved-label compatibility, 16-action oracle-set inclusion, policy regret, harmful false-on, beneficial false-off, and calibration

component_learning.missing_or_executor_invalid: excluded from resolved effect labels and counted as unresolved; never converted to OFF gold

formal_gate_each_head.oof_mse: at least 5 percent below the fold-training-mean predictor
formal_gate_each_head.support: nonconstant target and predictions across at least 12 independent clusters

component_learning.failed_head_policy: fail closed to OFF or the predeclared transparent rule without outcome-selected repair

component_correct_call_labels.purpose: diagnose whether a component request was supportable without forcing the continuous training target into a brittle binary label

quality_equivalence_margin.origin: predeclared practical indifference band, larger than one minimal aggregate scoring step and fixed before formal aggregation

labels.ON_ONLY: execution is valid and Q uplift is greater than +0.10
labels.OFF_ONLY: execution is valid and Q uplift is less than -0.10
labels.EITHER: execution is valid and absolute Q uplift is at most 0.10; cost or risk may later prefer OFF but does not rewrite the component value label
labels.UNRESOLVED: missing Q outcome, judge abstention/order conflict beyond the frozen resolver, transport failure, fallback, requested evidence not functionally used, or candidate/owner/time invalidity

risk_overlay.SAFE: risk was adjudicated and no resource-attributable material/critical event occurred
risk_overlay.UNSAFE: risk was adjudicated and a resource-attributable material/critical event occurred
risk_overlay.UNRESOLVED: risk was not adjudicated or attribution is unresolved
risk_overlay.independence_rule: risk overlay never rewrites the Q value label; final deployment/oracle-set eligibility requires SAFE, while benefit-only correctness is reported on the resolved Q denominator

required_reports: compatibility accuracy counting either action correct on EITHER
coverage over all groups and over resolved groups
unsafe_selected rate and risk-resolved coverage reported separately from value compatibility
prohibitions: executor failure proves the resource should be OFF
material risk rewrites a positive Q contribution as a negative Q label
cost makes an ON component effect negative

joint_action_oracle.panel: 32-48 outcome-blind common public-backbone states, each executed under all 16 actions after formal heads qualify
joint_action_oracle.same_state_requirement: all 16 actions use the same current state, candidate set, generator, seed schedule, guard, and evaluator; different actions may not be assigned to different states
oracle_set_construction: mark structurally infeasible, wrong-owner, future, or critical-risk actions invalid
among valid and risk-adjudicated actions, find the highest replicate-aggregated Q
retain every action within 0.10 Q of the best
within Q-equivalent actions, retain the exact minimum deterministic incremental injected-prompt-token cost frontier; all exact cost ties remain in the set
if measurement or risk status prevents this construction, mark the state oracle unresolved

primary_decision_metrics.oracle_set_inclusion_accuracy: fraction of resolved states where the PM action is a member of the oracle set
primary_decision_metrics.quality_regret: best safe valid Q minus selected-action Q; reported separately from cost
primary_decision_metrics.excess_deterministic_cost_on_quality_fro: selected deterministic incremental injected-prompt tokens minus the minimum among Q-equivalent safe actions
primary_decision_metrics.critical_invalid_action_rate: selected structurally invalid or critical-risk actions divided by all selected actions
primary_decision_metrics.requested_realized_exact_match: requested action equals realized action; ordinary M0+R0 is not fallback

cost_utility.form: lexicographic: exclude structural-invalid and material/critical-risk actions; apply the 0.10 Q indifference band; then minimize deterministic incremental injected-prompt tokens
cost_utility.cost_measure_for_oracle: deterministic incremental injected-prompt tokens computed before generation; realized provider tokens, USD, and latency remain separate outcomes

failure_owner_rules.catalog_or_adapter: candidate absent because a valid strictly-prior source was not materialized, or source owner/time/version is wrong before retrieval
failure_owner_rules.retriever: valid candidate exists but actual Rank-1 is semantically wrong, stale, redundant, or wrong-owner
failure_owner_rules.eligibility_or_semantic_interface: candidate is incorrectly hard-denied or incorrectly admitted by a deployment-visible rule/semantic feature
failure_owner_rules.pm: on a resolved oracle, PM selects OFF for ON_ONLY, ON for OFF_ONLY, or an action outside the joint oracle set
failure_owner_rules.step2_or_generator: PM requests an oracle-compatible action but evidence is not received/used, requested action is not realized, scaffold leaks, or fallback occurs
failure_owner_rules.resource_generator_interaction: candidate, eligibility, PM, and execution are valid but clean use still lowers Q or creates a material risk
failure_owner_rules.measurement: judge/human disagreement, missing outcome, evaluator failure, or unresolved risk adjudication
failure_owner_rules.scope_or_ood: state lies outside the frozen semantic or representation envelope and the system abstains/fails closed

two_views.deployment_itt: the deployed policy is charged with all downstream outcomes of its requested action, including fallback
two_views.mechanism_blame: the stagewise ledger separately identifies the earliest supported causal failure owner

response_system_metrics_carried_forward.quality: blind same-state NetWin with ties retained and user/dialogue-cluster uncertainty; noninferiority margin -0.05
response_system_metrics_carried_forward.risk: absolute and paired material event rates; learned-minus-comparator upper margin +0.05; every severity-3 event listed
response_system_metrics_carried_forward.cost: provider-recorded generation input tokens; minimum practical reduction 10 percent versus fixed-high, with output tokens/USD/latency separate

no_feedback_rule: formal or external outcomes may be analyzed and reported but may not change this V5.3 representation, labels, margins, prompts, candidate ranking, or decision thresholds
